item.title: Lee Geon-tae "I Won't Debate Supplementary Investigation Rights"... Han Dong-hoon "Running Away Because He's Afraid of Losing?" (이건태 “보완수사권 토론 안 해”… 한동훈 “밀릴 것 같으니 도망치나”)
item.description:
Lee Geon-tae "I Won't Debate Supplementary Investigation Rights"... Han Dong-hoon "Running Away Because He's Afraid of Losing?" (이건태 “보완수사권 토론 안 해”… 한동훈 “밀릴 것 같으니 도망치나”)

Lee Geon-tae, a first-term lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea (representing Bucheon-si, Gyeonggi Province), announced on the 18th that he would not proceed with the public debate on the issue of prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights, which he had planned to hold with independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon (first-term, Buk-gu, Busan). In response, Representative Han said, "Representative Lee ran away ahead of the debate," and criticized the Democratic Party, asking, "Are you even a proper political party?" <<> Earlier, Representative Han had proposed a public debate to the Democratic Party on the 16th, and on the 17th, Representative Lee accepted, saying, "Do it with me." However, Representative Lee changed his stance within a day. Representative Lee advocates for the complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights, while Representative Han argues for their retention. <<> On this day, Representative Lee wrote on Facebook, "The reason I agreed to the debate was because I believed Han Dong-hoon, along with Yoon Suk Yeol, led the political prosecution's manipulated indictments as a responsible party. I wanted to clearly hold him accountable before the public." <<> He continued, "I take the many opinions and advice of my party comrades seriously," adding, "I will not proceed with this debate." This suggests that party members did not want a debate with Representative Han. He further stated, "From now on, I will move forward quietly with my party comrades, focusing solely on the success of the Lee Jae-myung government, the completion of prosecution reform, and the victory of the Democratic Party." <<> After Representative Lee announced the previous day that he would hold a public debate with Representative Han, reactions within the Democratic Party and among its supporters included, "Public opinion is overwhelmingly in favor of the necessity of supplementary investigation rights, so there's no benefit to gain from a debate," and "It will only increase Han Dong-hoon's stature." The two sides had even tentatively agreed to a debate on JTBC at 5 p.m. on the 22nd, but the debate was canceled after Representative Lee expressed his intention to withdraw on this day. <<> Immediately after Representative Lee's announcement of his withdrawal from the debate, Representative Han wrote on Facebook, "Representative Lee ran away ahead of the debate," and said, "I hear that because he thought he would be unilaterally overwhelmed in the debate, Democratic Party politicians and some supporters pressured him to run away." <<> Representative Han questioned, "Democratic Party, are you even a proper political party?" and added, "A proper party is done once it becomes embarrassing. The Democratic Party is finished." He continued, "The prohibition of supplementary investigation rights, pushed by the Lee Jae-myung Democratic Party regime that makes victims cry and sides with murderers like Jang Yun-gi, is an undertaking by people who lack such courage, skill, or decency." <<> Representative Han also said, "I also request this to JTBC, which prepared the debate broadcast. Since there isn't a single courageous person among the Democratic Party lawmakers, I ask that an anchor or reporter question them from the position of the Democratic Party regime's prohibition of supplementary investigation rights, and I will explain it to the public." <<> In a subsequent Facebook post, Representative Han wrote, "Did Representative Lee Geon-tae, Lee Jae-myung's lawyer from the Daejang-dong case and a Democratic Party lawmaker, stage a 'deception of the public' from the start with the intention of running away?" and "It's just like Lee Jae-myung's lawyer to implement 'Lee Jae-myung-style hotel economics'." <<> He then added, "Where is Representative Lee Geon-tae, Lee Jae-myung's lawyer from the Daejang-dong case, now? It would only be proper for him to at least apologize to me, the opponent who conceded on the broadcaster and date to accommodate him." (더불어민주당 이건태(초선·경기 부천병) 의원은 18일 무소속 한동훈(초선·부산 북갑) 의원과 검찰 보완수사권 문제를 두고 벌이기로 했던 공개 토론을 하지 않겠다고 밝혔다. 이에 대해 한 의원은 “이 의원이 토론을 앞두고 도망쳤다”며 민주당을 향해 “공당이 맞느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: National Assembly Puts Shin Ik-hee Ahead of Syngman Rhee... Opposition Calls Constitutional Day Event “Inappropriate Action” (이승만 아닌 신익희 앞세운 국회... 野, 제헌절 행사에 “부적절 처사”)
item.description:
National Assembly Puts Shin Ik-hee Ahead of Syngman Rhee... Opposition Calls Constitutional Day Event “Inappropriate Action” (이승만 아닌 신익희 앞세운 국회... 野, 제헌절 행사에 “부적절 처사”)

The People Power Party criticized the National Assembly on the 18th for putting Shin Ik-hee, the first vice speaker and inaugural leader of the Democratic Party, ahead of former President Syngman Rhee, the first speaker of the Constituent Assembly, during the previous day’s Constitutional Day ceremony, calling it an “inappropriate action.” (국민의힘은 18일 국회가 전날 제헌절 경축식에서 제헌 국회 초대 의장인 이승만 전 대통령보다 초대 부의장이자 민주당 초대 당수인 신익희 선생을 앞세운 데 대해 “부적절한 처사”라고 비판했다.)

Kim Tae-gyu, senior deputy floor leader of the People Power Party, said in a commentary, “National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, rather than controlling the Democratic Party’s legislative rampage, has in effect supported it, undermining the neutrality and authority of the National Assembly,” adding, “Moreover, in the AI-based video ‘Reading of the Preamble of the Constitution by Constituent Assembly Members’ at the Constitutional Day ceremony, Shin Ik-hee was placed before former President Syngman Rhee, who was the first speaker of the Constituent Assembly, sparking unnecessary historical controversy.” He went on to say, “Even at an event emphasizing the spirit of the constitution, causing controversy over the symbols of constitutional history is a highly inappropriate act for the speaker representing the National Assembly.” (국민의힘 김태규 원내수석대변인은 이날 논평에서 “조정식 국회의장은 민주당의 입법 폭주를 제어하기는커녕 사실상 뒷받침하며 국회의 중립성과 권위를 스스로 실추시켰다”며 “심지어 제헌절 경축식에서는 AI(인공지능) 기반 ‘제헌 국회 의원 헌법 전문 낭독’ 영상에서 제헌 국회 초대 의장이었던 이승만 전 대통령보다 신익희 선생을 먼저 배치해 불필요한 역사 논란까지 자초했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “헌법 정신을 강조하는 자리에서조차 헌정사의 상징을 둘러싼 논란을 자초한 것은 국회를 대표하는 국회의장으로서 매우 부적절한 처사”라고 했다.)

Regarding the proposal for constitutional amendments made by National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik at the Constitutional Day ceremony, Kim also said, “The proper order is to first reflect on whether the current spirit of the constitution is being properly realized in the National Assembly,” adding, “We can never agree with attempts to push constitutional amendments out of political necessity while ignoring the spirit of the constitution.” (김 대변인은 또한 조정식 국회의장이 제헌절 경축식에서 제안한 개헌에 대해서도 “지금의 헌법 정신이 국회에서 제대로 구현되고 있는지부터 성찰하는 것이 순서”라며 “헌법 정신을 외면한 채 정치적 필요에 따라 개헌을 앞세우는 시도에는 결코 동의할 수 없다”고 했다.)

The previous day, at the “78th Constitutional Day Ceremony” held at the National Assembly, a video was screened using AI technology in which 198 members of the Constituent Assembly read the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Korea. However, the first person to appear was not former President Syngman Rhee, the first speaker of the Constituent Assembly, but former National Assembly Speaker Shin Ik-hee, who served as the first vice speaker and later as speaker. Former President Rhee appeared second, after former Speaker Shin. (앞서 전날 국회에서 열린 ‘제78회 제헌절 경축식’에서는 AI 기술을 활용해 제헌 국회의원 198인이 제헌헌법 전문(前文)을 낭독하는 동영상이 상영됐다. 그런데 가장 먼저 등장한 사람은 제헌 국회 초대 의장이었던 이승만 전 대통령이 아니라, 초대 국회 부의장이었다가 이후 의장을 맡은 신익희 전 국회의장이었다. 이 전 대통령은 신 전 의장에 이어 두 번째로 등장했다.)

In response, political circles speculated, “Since National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik is from the Democratic Party, did he put former Speaker Shin Ik-hee at the front?” and “Was he opposed to having former President Syngman Rhee, who is not from his faction, appear first?” The Democratic Party traces its political roots to the Democratic Party founded in 1955 by former Speaker Shin and others, and former Speaker Shin was the inaugural leader of that party. (이를 두고 정치권에서는 “조정식 국회의장이 민주당 출신이라 신익희 전 의장을 맨 앞에 세운 것 아니냐” “자기 진영 인사가 아닌 이승만 전 대통령이 맨 앞에 나오는 건 싫다는 것이냐”는 등의 말이 나왔다. 민주당은 자신들의 정치적 뿌리를 1955년 신 전 의장 등이 창당한 민주당에 두고 있는데, 신 전 의장은 민주당의 초대 당수였다.)

Regarding the ordering, the National Assembly explained, “Former President Rhee served in the Constituent Assembly for only two months before becoming the first president,” and “We considered that former Speaker Shin had a greater symbolic role in the constitution, having worked on the first and second drafts of the Constitution of the Republic of Korea and served as speaker of the Constituent Assembly and the second National Assembly.” The explanation was that, given former President Rhee’s short tenure in the Constituent Assembly, the vice speaker was placed ahead of the first speaker. (국회 측은 순서 배치에 대해 “이 전 대통령은 제헌 국회에서 2개월간 활동한 뒤 초대 대통령이 됐다”며 “신 전 의장은 제헌 헌법의 1·2단계 초안 작업을 하고 제헌 국회 의장과 2대 의장을 하는 등 제헌 헌법의 상징성이 더 크다는 점을 고려했다”고 설명했다. 이 전 대통령의 제헌 국회 활동 기간이 짧은 점을 감안해 초대 의장이 아닌 부의장을 앞세웠다는 것이다.)

item.title: President Lee orders "all-out effort" to extinguish Incheon Coupang warehouse fire (李 대통령, 인천 쿠팡 물류창고 화재에 “진압에 총력” 지시)
item.description:
President Lee orders "all-out effort" to extinguish Incheon Coupang warehouse fire (李 대통령, 인천 쿠팡 물류창고 화재에 “진압에 총력” 지시)

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung on the 18th received a report on the firefighting situation at the Coupang logistics warehouse in Seohae-gu, Incheon, and ordered all-out efforts to extinguish the fire and take every precaution to prevent the damage from spreading. <<> Chief Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung made this announcement in a media notice, stating, "President Lee emphasized thorough safety measures for firefighters at the scene." <<> According to the Incheon Fire Department, a fire broke out on the sixth floor of Coupang's 32nd logistics center in Seoknam-dong, Seohae-gu, Incheon, at around 6:54 AM that day. Fire authorities issued a national fire mobilization order as of 3:15 PM, but it is reported that household goods stored inside and thick smoke are making firefighting difficult. As a result, it is expected to take a considerable amount of time to extinguish the blaze. <<>> ()

item.title: North Korea Reacts to Korea-US-Japan Chiefs of Staff Meeting, Calling It “Source of Destruction of Peace and Stability” (北, 한미일 합참의장 회의 반발…“평화·안정 파괴하는 근원”)
item.description:
North Korea Reacts to Korea-US-Japan Chiefs of Staff Meeting, Calling It “Source of Destruction of Peace and Stability” (北, 한미일 합참의장 회의 반발…“평화·안정 파괴하는 근원”)

North Korea condemned the decision by the Chiefs of Staff of South Korea, the United States, and Japan to continue the annual trilateral joint military exercise, “Freedom Edge,” calling it “a source of destruction of peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region.” <<> According to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) on the 18th, a spokesperson for North Korea’s Ministry of National Defense stated in a commentary that day, “This stems from the unchanging hostile designs of the US, Japan, and South Korea to secure military superiority in the region through the strengthening of triangular military cooperation and pursue their hegemonic geopolitical interests.” <<> The spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defense said, “We sound the alarm on the danger of the provocative triangular military cooperation of the US, Japan, and South Korea, which creates worrisome military confrontation and the potential for conflict on the Korean Peninsula, and we issue a grave warning about the negative consequences this will bring to the regional security environment.” <<> Furthermore, while citing the ROK-US joint air exercise “Ssangmae” conducted at Osan Air Base and the multinational maritime exercise “RIMPAC 2026” held in Hawaii, the spokesperson stated, “The serious security challenges that the triangular military cooperation of the US, Japan, and South Korea creates on the Korean Peninsula and beyond can never be overlooked.” <<> The spokesperson added, “In response to these posed threats, we will maintain a responsible will and take effective action to curb the military provocations of hostile nations and thoroughly manage the security environment on the Korean Peninsula.” <<> The spokesperson also reaffirmed North Korea’s position of adhering to the line of strengthening its nuclear forces as stipulated in the North Korean constitution. “From a position of strong power, we will never allow any imbalance of power in the region forced by the military collusion of the US, Japan, and South Korea,” the spokesperson said, adding, “We will always remain faithful to our constitutional mission to neutralize current security challenges and future threats and to reliably safeguard national security and regional peace.” <<> Earlier, on the 15th (local time), Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) Kim Myung-soo, U.S. Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Charles Q. Brown Jr., and Japanese Chief of Staff, Joint Staff, General Yoshihide Yoshida held the 23rd Korea-U.S.-Japan JCS meeting in Washington, D.C. The Chiefs of Staff discussed trilateral security cooperation measures, including the conduct of the Korea-U.S.-Japan multi-domain joint military exercise “Freedom Edge.” Amid Russia and China, which are aligned with North Korea, turning a blind eye to the North Korean nuclear issue, this is interpreted as the United States, which maintains the goal of “complete denuclearization of North Korea,” showing its will to continue joint responses among South Korea, the U.S., and Japan. (북한은 한·미·일 합참의장이 3국 간 연례 연합 군사훈련인 ‘프리덤 에지(Freedom Edge)’를 지속 실시하기로 한 데 대해 “조선반도(한반도)와 아시아태평양 지역의 평화와 안정을 파괴하는 근원”이라고 비난했다.)
